cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(NekoUI LANGUAGES CXX)

option(NEKOUI_BUILD_EXAMPLES "Build the example programs" ON)

add_library(NekoUI INTERFACE)
add_library(NekoUI::NekoUI ALIAS NekoUI)
target_include_directories(NekoUI INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
target_compile_features(NekoUI INTERFACE cxx_std_17)

if(NOT VITA)
  find_package(SDL2 REQUIRED)
  find_package(SDL2_ttf QUIET)
  find_package(SDL2_image QUIET)
  find_package(SDL2_mixer QUIET)

  set(NEKOUI_SDL_LIBS "")
  if(TARGET SDL2::SDL2)
    list(APPEND NEKOUI_SDL_LIBS SDL2::SDL2)
  else()
    target_include_directories(NekoUI INTERFACE ${SDL2_INCLUDE_DIRS})
    list(APPEND NEKOUI_SDL_LIBS ${SDL2_LIBRARIES})
  endif()

  find_package(PkgConfig QUIET)
  foreach(lib ttf image mixer)
    string(TOUPPER ${lib} LIBUP)
    if(TARGET SDL2_${lib}::SDL2_${lib})
      list(APPEND NEKOUI_SDL_LIBS SDL2_${lib}::SDL2_${lib})
    elseif(PkgConfig_FOUND)
      pkg_check_modules(NEKO_${LIBUP} REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET SDL2_${lib})
      list(APPEND NEKOUI_SDL_LIBS PkgConfig::NEKO_${LIBUP})
    else()
      message(FATAL_ERROR "SDL2_${lib} was not found")
    endif()
  endforeach()

  target_link_libraries(NekoUI INTERFACE ${NEKOUI_SDL_LIBS})
endif()

if(NEKOUI_BUILD_EXAMPLES)
  set(NEKOUI_EXAMPLES hello tutorial custom_widget demo)
  foreach(example ${NEKOUI_EXAMPLES})
    add_executable(neko_${example} examples/${example}.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(neko_${example} PRIVATE NekoUI::NekoUI)
    set_target_properties(neko_${example} PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)
    if(MSVC)
      target_compile_options(neko_${example} PRIVATE /W3)
    else()
      target_compile_options(neko_${example} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
    endif()
  endforeach()

  add_custom_target(neko_assets ALL
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/assets)
  foreach(example ${NEKOUI_EXAMPLES})
    add_dependencies(neko_${example} neko_assets)
  endforeach()
endif()
